description: This file defines a Flutter widget named ExpensePieChart that visualizes expense data as a pie chart with a corresponding legend. It uses custom painting to render the pie slices and displays expense categories with percentages.

classes.name: ExpensePieChart
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays a pie chart representing expense data with category labels and percentages.

classes.name: _PiePainter
classes.description: A CustomPainter responsible for drawing the pie slices based on expense data.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for ExpensePieChart, including the pie visualization and legend.

methods.name: _PiePainter.paint
methods.description: Draws the pie slices on the canvas based on the expense data.

methods.name: _PiePainter.shouldRepaint
methods.description: Determines when the custom painter should repaint based on changes to the data.
